title: Study plan
description: How many semester? What exams will you have to take? Discover the study progamme of the Master in Digital Fashion Communication.

blocks.html:
Overview

The MSc in Digital Fashion Communication (DFC) prepares select students to pursue their careers in the fashion industry as specialists in digital communication.

The Master is a two-year (120 ECTS) Double Master's Degree offered jointly by USI - Università della Svizzera italiana and Université Paris 1 Panthéon-Sorbonne and is entirely given in English. The courses offered in Paris will also be in English. The programme is taught by a renowned faculty from both institutions and by a large number of guest lecturers and professionals of the fashion industry who will share their practical experience. Mobility is part of the learning experience offered by this Master. Students will study in two different locations (Lugano and Paris) and live two diverse cultures.

Study plan

The study plan and course descriptions provide an overview of the programme’s structure and content, and may be subject to changes.
Enrolled students should refer to the GESTU platform, where they can access the course offering, updated progressively each semester.

View Study plan (PDF)

items.title: Semester at Paris 1
items.html:
In their third semester, students will live and study full-time in English at the prestigious Université Paris 1 Panthéon-Sorbonne. This semester will be a full immersion in the world of fashion. Students will deepen their understanding of the long-term socio-cultural processes that shape fashion and drive its impact on society. They will be exposed to the fashion industry through lectures and company visits.

Students will have the possibility to remain in Paris also for the fourth semester.

During their period of choice (one semester or one year) at Paris, students have the opportunity to undertake their required internship, and/or work on their Master Thesis.

The semester at Université Paris 1 Panthéon-Sorbonne in Paris is mandatory for all the students enrolled in the Master in Digital Fashion Communication. The students are responsible for securing their visa and permit to study in France.

More detailed information will be provided once enrolled in the master.

items.title: Internship and Master Thesis
items.html:
In addition to providing students with the knowledge necessary to excel in their future careers, this master requires students to apply that knowledge and gain hands-on experience through two main activities: an internship and a master thesis.

Internship

Students are required to complete a two months internship (9 ECTS) in a company of their choice. Thanks to the mobility aspect of this master, students will have the opportunity to create an international network of contacts that will help them in finding the internship opportunity they desire.

Students can do their internship during their fourth semester in whichever location they prefer.

During this semester, they will have an online course and their master thesis, which gives them the flexibility to find an internship outside of Switzerland or France if desired.

Get inspiration from the Internship stories in Digital Fashion Communication!

Master Thesis

During the last semester, students will be researching and writing their Master Thesis (18 ECTS) on a topic of their choice related to the digital fashion communication domain.

The University Library of the Lugano Campus offers our students a rich collection of specialist literature available both online and offline. The Institute of Digital Technologies for Communication offers eye-tracking technologies and other useful tools for digital communication research.

More detailed information will be provided once enrolled in the master.

items.title: Study Tours
items.html:
Mobility is an important part of the learning experience offered by the Master in Digital Fashion Communication. Students are not only required to study in two different locations and live diverse cultures, but are also encouraged to move and meet new realities in the fashion industry through a set of study tours.

Destinations will be chosen among Switzerland, Italy, Spain and France's fashion historical districts and industry hubs. The tours will include visits to factories, ateliers, museums, and company headquarters. All related activities, which might include case history presentations delivered by managers and industry experts, will be organized during the first three semesters of the programme and will be accredited 3 ECTS, as a single course.

Travel and subsistence costs of study tours are not included in the tuition fee and are to be covered by the students.

You can get the flavour of the study tours that the students have attended on our Instagram or LinkedIn profiles.

items.title: Teaching and programme management
items.html:
The MSc in Digital Fashion Communication is taught by a highly specialized and international faculty from Università della Svizzera italiana and Université Paris 1 Panthéon-Sorbonne, as well as by visiting professors from ISEM Fashion Business School and other institutions.

Academic Co-Directors: Prof. Lorenzo Cantoni & Prof. Francesca Cominelli

Programme Coordinator: Dr. Nadzeya Sabatini

items.title: Achievements of our students
items.html:
In addition to attending formal courses, doing curricular internships, and writing their Master theses, the students of the Master's in Digital Fashion Communication are actively participating in various extracurricular activities promoted by the Master's program.

We invite students to participate in innovation scouting projects, creativity challenges, think tanks, and academic conferences.

These are some of the examples of when our students won in such competitions.

  • Martina Ronchetti, Linda Leppänen, Federica Fava, Laura Cadenazzi, Giulia Tettamanti are the Winners of the La Martina Digital Creativity Challenge
  • Arianna Pittaluga, Camilla Cappellini, and Ewa Węgrzy are the Winners of Bulgari Swiss Genius Innovation Award 2022
  • Pietro Lattao, Francesca Manna, and Michele Storelli are the Winners of Bulgari Swiss Genius Innovation Award 2023
  • Alessia Anicito is the Winner of Concorso Ticinomoda 2024 for the best Master thesis.
  • Veronica Espejo is the Winner of Concorso Ticinomoda 2025 for the best Master thesis.
  • Dai Zhu, Dr. Nadzeya Sabatini, and Dr. Nicoletta Fornara won the best paper award for their article "Usability Challenges in Sentiment Analysis Tools: A Dual Approach for the Fashion Industry" presented at the FACTUM25 Fashion Communication Conference.
  • Lorenzo Destefani and Giorgia Insabato are the Winners of Concorso Ticinomoda 2026 for the best Master thesis.
  • Beatrice Albonico is the finalist of the Call-for-Needs project proposed by the Start-up Garage SUPSI and Moncler.
